lifecycle.description: The process that is this entity's lifecycle.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

checks.description: Conditions every record of the entity meets. A database enforces one only through a binding that lists it.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.description: What revisions of this entity look like and what a revise does to an instance (revisions-design.md decisions 1 to 11 and 32 to 36): one to three levels and a separator, optionally the attribute that holds the current revision, and per lifecycle, attribute and relation end what a revise does. A derived entity inherits its bases' block and overrides it item by item: levels, separator and boundAttribute from the nearest statement, entries added to its bases' and replacing a base's entry for the same lifecycle, attribute or end.

levels.description: One to three levels, from the most significant. Absent: a base's levels (MQ8301 when the family names none).

items.title: Revision level
items.description: A run of letters (A to Z, then AA, AB and on), of whole numbers, or a list of values: exactly one of format and values (MQ8301).

name.description: A label for templates, docs and the editor, unique among the levels (MQ8301); without one the level is level n. Lifecycles and steps name a level by its number.

format.description: letters: upper case A to Z, then AA, AB and on, never running out; numbers: whole numbers from first, with no end.

values.description: A list of values, used in order; the level ends at its last value, where it can't move.

first.description: The level's first value: a letter run for letters (absent: the first letter not skipped), a whole number for numbers (absent: 1). Not beside values (MQ8301).

skip.description: Letters never used, at any position, for a letters level only (MQ8301).

width.description: For a numbers level only (MQ8301): numbers are padded with zeros to this width, and a value past it grows.

startEmpty.description: true: the level holds nothing at first, and again whenever a higher level moves; it takes its first value when it or a lower level moves. Every level below one that starts empty starts empty too (MQ8301). Absent: false.

separator.description: Written between two levels that both hold a value. Absent: a base's, else ".". It may be empty only between a letters level and a numbers level, and never holds a letter or a digit (MQ8303).

boundAttribute.description: The id of the attribute that holds the current revision (decision 10): a single-valued, non-derived string or text attribute the entity holds, which only revising moves (MQ8305). Absent: a base's, else the team's system holds it.

lifecycles.description: What a revise does to each lifecycle that governs the entity. A lifecycle not listed starts over.

lifecycle.description: The id of a lifecycle that governs the entity or a derived entity (MQ8312).

onRevise.description: restart: back to the initial state; keep: the states stay as they are; or the id of a state of the lifecycle, entered as a restart enters the initial one.

attributes.description: What a revise does to each listed attribute the entity holds. An attribute not listed is copied.

attribute.description: The id of an attribute the entity holds: its own, an inherited one or one from a stereotype it carries (MQ8312).

onRevise.description: reset: the attribute's default, else empty; clear: empty; copy: the earlier value, so a derived entity can undo a base's entry.

links.description: What a revise does to the links through each listed relation end the entity reaches. An end not listed is left to the team.

end.description: The id of a relation end the entity navigates to (MQ8312).

onRevise.description: stay: the earlier revision keeps the link; move: the link goes with the new revision; duplicate: the new revision gets a link of its own (MQ8308 where the entity's own end has max 1).

copy.title: Copy
copy.description: What a copy of a whole record of this entity carries over (parts-and-copy-design.md): a copy is a new record made from an existing one, with copies of its composition parts. Per attribute and to-one link, and per kind of part, what the copy gets; anything not listed is copied as it is. Links inside the copy point at the copies; links out of the copy stay as they were. A derived entity inherits its bases' block, a nearer entry replacing a farther one for the same attribute or end.

attributes.description: What the copy's value of each listed attribute is. An attribute not listed is copied as it is.

links.description: What the copy's link through each listed to-one relation end is. An end not listed keeps the original's link.

end.description: The id of a to-one end at the other side of a two-ended relation of the entity, not a composition (MQ3045); it needs no navigation.

onCopy.description: original: the copy links to the record it was copied from (MQ3046, the end's type must cover the entity); copy: the original's link, so a derived entity can undo a base's entry.

parts.description: Which parts of each listed kind the copy carries over. A kind not listed is copied whole. A part the copy leaves out leaves its own parts out too.

end.description: The id of the part end of a composition among the entity's parts, at any level (MQ3047).

onCopy.description: all: every part; one: one part under each copied owner, chosen as choose says; none: no part of the kind.

choose.title: Copy choice
choose.description: With one only (MQ3047): the part that meets the condition or is in the state, the latest by latestBy among several; when none does, the latest of all by latestBy. At least one key, and not both condition and state.

condition.description: A condition on the part's own attributes: the part for which it is true.

state.description: The id of a state of a lifecycle that governs the part's entity: the part in that state (MQ3048).

latestBy.description: The id of an attribute of the part with an order (a number, a text, a date or a time): the latest is the one with the greatest value (MQ3048).

attributes.description: What the copied parts' value of each listed attribute is. An attribute not listed is copied as it is.

bindings.description: How the entity reads from and writes to databases, one binding per database (erratum E43). A binding wins over any projection of the entity into its database.

items.title: Binding
items.description: How the entity reads from and writes to one database (erratum E43): where it reads, the constant columns, the field map, the columns it accounts for without a field, where it writes back and how it deletes. One per database (MQ4050).

source.description: What the entity reads: the id of a table (or a synthesized table key), a view or a query of the database.

baseForeignKey.description: Table per type: the id of a foreign key of the binding's write table (else its source) that references the write table of the binding to the same database of the entity's nearest bound base. Its columns are the table's whole primary key. The base's binding maps the inherited attributes and to-one ends, its constants and its type column; this binding maps only the entity's own, and no field for the key: the key is the foreign key's columns. Inserts write the base's row first (a key the base generates flows in), reads join the base's table, up the chain (MQ4128 to MQ4136).

constants.description: Columns with a fixed value: a filter on every read and a value on every insert.

column.description: A column of the source (and of the write table): its key or physical name.

value.description: The value; absent or null is SQL NULL.

fields.description: The field map: an attribute of the entity (attributeId.memberId for a value object member, a relation end id for a to-one navigation's key or, on an end with several types, its id; endId.type for that end's type code and endId.entityId for its key per type) and the source column it reads.

attribute.description: An attribute id of the entity, attributeId.memberId, or the id of a relation end the entity holds, which a to-one navigation leads to: endId maps its key column, or on an end with several types its id column; endId.type maps the column that holds the linked object's type code, and endId.entityId the column that points at a linked object of that entity (a column per type).

column.description: A column of the source: its key or physical name.

columns.description: Source columns no field maps, each accounted for: ignored, filled by the database (never written) or computed.

column.description: A column of the source or the write table: its key or physical name.

write.description: Where the entity writes: { "table": id } or "none". Absent: the source when it is a table, none when it is a view or a query.

table.description: The id of a table of the database (or a synthesized table key).

delete.description: How the entity deletes: "key", { "soft": { "column", "value" } } or "none". Absent: key when the binding writes, none otherwise.

column.description: A column of the write table: its key or physical name.

value.description: The value set; absent or null is SQL NULL.

discriminatorColumn.description: The type column a base entity shares with the entities derived from it in one table: a column of the source (and of the write table), its key or physical name. The binding of each derived entity to the same database inherits it from its nearest base whose binding names one: the derived entity's type code (its discriminatorValue, else its name) then filters its reads, updates and deletes, and is the value its insert writes. The base reads every row of its hierarchy in the table, subtypes included; its insert writes its own code. A derived entity in the base's table inherits the column and may not name one (MQ4126). A field on the column is read but never written.

discriminatorValue.description: The entity's type code in this database, where a type column holds it: a column of a relation end with several types, or the type column its base's discriminatorColumn names. Absent: the discriminatorValue of the entity's mapping there, else the entity's name. An entity outside a hierarchy takes one only when an end with several types covers it (MQ4009).

provenance.title: Binding provenance
provenance.description: The columns of a table-file source as the last by-name operation (materialize, map-by-name, resync-binding) recorded them, for the drift report and MQ4087. Written by the engine only; a save leaves it as it is, and removing it stops drift reports for the binding. Its keys are records, not references: a column delete never sees them.

columns.description: Column id (an inherited column by its keyed id, <tableId>.<memberId>) to "<name part>:<type part>": two short hashes of the column's name, compared loosely, and of its type, facets and nullability.

checks.description: The ids of the entity's checks the write table enforces, lowered through the field map (MQ3110). A check no binding lists reaches no table.

copyAttribute.title: Copy attribute entry
copyAttribute.description: What a copy's value of one attribute is.

attribute.description: The id of an attribute the record holds: its own, an inherited one or one from a stereotype it carries; never a key or derived attribute (MQ3045).

onCopy.description: reset: the attribute's default, else empty (on a column the database fills, the database's default, so the copy gets a fresh value); clear: empty; neither clear, nor reset without a default, on a required attribute (MQ3045); original: the id of the record it was copied from (MQ3046); copy: the original's value, so a derived entity can undo a base's entry.
